content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The Government Children Home for Girls, Jangaon (Balasadanam) has announced a total of 6 vacancies for women candidates on an outsourcing basis under Mission Vatsalya.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible women candidates may apply for these posts. Candidates must have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 44 years of age on 01.10.2026. The upper age limit is relaxed by five years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Backward Classes, and by ten years for persons with benchmark disabilities. Local candidates of Jangaon District, as defined in the Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres and Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order 2018, will be selected first in order of merit. Qualifications required for each post are as follows: Counsellor: Degree in Psychology, Counselling, Public Health, Social Work, Sociology, Education, Food and Nutrition or Home Science, from a recognised University; or post graduate diploma in Counselling and Communication. Child Welfare Officer: Degree, preferably B.A. in Social Work, Sociology or Social Sciences, or LL.B., from a recognised University. Store Keeper cum Accountant: Degree in Commerce, Finance or Accounting, from a recognised University. Paramedical Staff: Pass in the course of Auxiliary Nursing and Midwifery recognised by the Indian Nursing Council or the Telangana Nursing Council. Attender: Ability to read and write Telugu. Sevika: No educational qualification is prescribed. The candidate shall be able to read and write Telugu.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be by a written examination followed on the same day by an oral test of 25 marks. For posts at Sl.No.1 to 3, the written test carries 200 objective questions for 90 minutes in English. For Sl.No.4, the test carries 100 objective questions for 60 minutes in English and Telugu. For Sl.No.5 and 6, the test carries 50 objective questions for 45 minutes in Telugu and English. Each question carries one mark with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. Five bonus marks are added for candidates belonging to specified vulnerable categories upon production of valid certificates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Collector Office and District Magistrate Jangaon Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Annexure I of the notification or official district website. Fill out the application form entirely in the hand of the candidate. Affix a recent passport size photograph at the top right and sign across it. Attach self-attested copies of SSC certificate, qualification certificates and marks memos, experience certificates, study certificates from Class I to VII (or residence certificate), community certificate (if age relaxation is claimed), disability certificate, category certificate for 5 bonus marks, identity proof, and two passport size photographs. Hand over the filled application form at the Inward Section of the Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon between 13.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 (working days 10.30 AM to 5.00 PM, Saturday up to 1.00 PM), or send it by registered post or speed post superscribed with the name of the post to reach by 5.00 PM on 17.10.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit applications for Jangaon Children Home recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 17.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Is the engagement permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is on an outsourcing basis for one year at a time, in the first instance up to 31.03.2027, and is not service under the Government.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only eligible women candidates who fulfill the required educational qualifications and age limits (21 to 44 years as on 01.10.2026 with applicable relaxations) may apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
Q5. Who gets extra marks during selection?
faq.answer: Five marks will be added to the total score of candidates belonging to vulnerable categories such as care leavers/orphans, women who lived in a Government hostel or home for persons with disabilities, women who worked as Block Project Assistant under Poshan Abhiyaan and lost work, and single women (widows, divorced, or deserted women) upon producing valid certificates.
